result.summary:
Confirmed via `git diff main...HEAD --name-only`: the only non-handoff/design-doc file changed is test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs (42 lines, assertion-logic only -- no lib/letflow/**, no priv/repo/migrations/**, no config/**). Full content diff reviewed: every hunk either (a) replaces a whole-baseline-set equality assertion (`assert sandbox_schema_names() == baseline` / `== MapSet.put(baseline, o_schema)`) with membership assertions scoped to the specific schema name(s) this test itself created/claimed (`refute MapSet.member?(final, o_schema)`, `assert MapSet.member?(...)`), to stop false failures from concurrent tests' schemas being visible in the same shared Postgres instance, or (b) captures a `schema_name` field out of an existing `%SandboxClaim{}` pattern match (already being asserted, just not previously bound) so the new scoped assertions have a value to compare against. No new assertion targets, no new I/O, no new schema-creation/drop calls, no new Repo.query call sites, no new external inputs. Per-invariant verdict below.

INV-1 (tenant data isolation): NOT-APPLICABLE. No Ecto schema module, business table, or migration touched. `SandboxPool`'s per-test Postgres schemas are test-isolation infrastructure (each ExUnit test gets its own throwaway schema to sandbox DB state), not tenant business data reachable via the app's `:prefix` mechanism -- REQ-102/0003-ecto-schema-strategy's tenant scoping does not apply to test fixtures.

INV-2 (server-side field authorisation): NOT-APPLICABLE. No API response type, router, or serialization path touched -- this is a test file exercising `Letflow.SandboxPool` GenServer state directly (`:sys.get_state/1`), not a client-facing response.

INV-3 (untrusted runtime sandboxing): NOT-APPLICABLE. No Lua/WASM host function or capability-gate code touched. (Note: 'sandbox' here is Postgres per-test schema isolation, unrelated to the Lua/WASM script sandbox this invariant governs -- confirmed by reading the actual module under test, not assumed from the name.)

INV-4 (secrets by reference only): APPLIES (checkable on every diff per its own text) and PASS. `grep -n "System.get_env\|password\|secret\|client_secret\|token" test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs` returned zero hits on any changed line. No secret material introduced, logged, or serialized by this diff.

INV-5 (not-found/forbidden indistinguishability): NOT-APPLICABLE. No lookup-by-ID endpoint added or changed; nothing here resolves a tenant-scoped resource by caller-supplied id.

INV-6 (new data-access paths prove scoping): NOT-APPLICABLE as a distinct check -- no new data-access path exists in this diff (see INV-1); this handoff itself is the meta-invariant's own instance being discharged for this branch.

INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation): NOT-APPLICABLE to this diff. `grep -n "Repo.query" test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs` finds pre-existing `Repo.query!` calls with `#{schema_name}`/`~s()` interpolation at lines 118/127/136/575/593/1577/1581 (test-harness schema create/drop helpers using internally-generated, not tenant- or caller-controlled, schema name strings) -- none of these lines fall inside any hunk in `git diff main...HEAD` for this file; they are untouched by this change and pre-date this branch, so this diff introduces no new raw-SQL interpolation to evaluate.

INV-8 (no unhandled crashes on realistic failure paths): NOT-APPLICABLE. This invariant's verify procedure and reference scope target `lib/letflow/**` production/shared-process code; the diff touches only `test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs` test assertions (`assert`/`refute` forms, which are supposed to raise on a real defect -- that is ExUnit's normal failure signal, not an unhandled-crash risk to another tenant's in-flight work). No production error-handling path was added or changed.

Overall: out of scope for a BLOCKER-relevant tenant-data path (INV-1/2/3/5/6 all NOT-APPLICABLE, confirmed from the actual diff, not assumed from the handoff's own characterization), and the two invariants that are checkable on any diff regardless of scope (INV-4, INV-7 heuristic; INV-8 heuristic) find nothing new to flag. PASS.
